bower-2024.citation: Bower, Furey and the UGOS Scientific Team (2024), Toward an Operational Observing System for the Gulf of Mexico. UGOS Annual Meeting, College Station, 30 September–2 October 2024. Institutional poster hosted by Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution.
bower-2024.access: Original institutional poster PDF acquired. Actual poster, named Berek map, axis labels and frontal-analysis legend visually reviewed; original native PDF path, explicit endpoint closure and axes independently extracted and verified.

pdf_line_cases.coordinate_system: PDF points, equivalent to pixels in a 72 dpi rendering
pdf_line_cases.axis_method: Piecewise linear interpolation between published tick-label centers; no projection or source-field accuracy inferred.
pdf_line_cases.poster_overlay_qualification: Observing-platform symbols and planned-program overlays hide parts of the line in the rendered poster. Extents come from the original source-native path, not repaired pixels or a reconstructed boundary.

records.source_locator: Single-page UGOS poster, central map label Eddy Berek and lower-right Other / Frontal Analysis legend; native drawing index 217, sequence 254.
records.period_label: Poster map uses 2023-12-21 SSH background; frontal-line observation date unspecified
records.definition: Bounding east–west arc span of the source-native plotted frontal-analysis line enclosing the Berek label. Legend describes the frontal analysis as a 1.5-knot contour. Not whole-eddy radius or diameter.
records.scope: Named Berek source-case reference only. The poster combines a dated SSH background with active/planned observing systems; it does not independently date the frontal line. Registry physical crosswalk unverified.
records.qualification: Original 3500-segment PDF line is continuous and explicitly closes at its repeated endpoint despite closePath=false. No missing segment reconstructed or pixel gap repaired. Overlay-obscured parts are retained from the original native path, not inferred. Axis values use piecewise interpolation between published tick-label centers, with 6 PDF points (equivalent to six 72 dpi pixels) reading allowance and outward 25 km rounding. The range describes source-line reading only, not field accuracy, measurement uncertainty or seasonal extrema. SSH background date is not assigned as the contour observation date. No physical footprint, source-data polygon, radius, diameter, occupied area, state containment or seasonal playback inferred. Research candidate only; original source assets not republished.
